Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded the task prematurely without engaging any available capabilities (WebSurfer, FileSurfer, Coder, CodeExecutor) to verify the biological facts. It relied on a flawed internal reasoning process that confused the function of leaves (photosynthesis/sunlight capture) with the function of the canopy regarding precipitation (interception/stemflow). The ground truth explicitly states the answer is "to capture sunlight," but the Planner selected "to collect water" based on a misinterpretation of the ecological role of the upper canopy versus the physiological role of the leaves themselves. This matches the error pattern of "Premature TASK_COMPLETE Decision" and "Misinterpretation of task requirements" seen in the reference examples.
